jobs.title: Lecturer in Ethics and/or Politics
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility: the role explicitly requires a PhD in Philosophy (awarded or viva passed) at time of appointment, which the candidate (MSc in progress) does not hold. It is also a permanent academic lectureship requiring an established research programme and teaching/module-design experience.

jobs.title: Management System Lead Auditor & Verifier for Saudi Arabia
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch: this is a senior ISO management-systems auditor role requiring an engineering degree, 5+ years of certification-audit experience, and ISO 14064 training — none of which the candidate has. Field (industrial assurance/auditing) is entirely off-profile, and native Arabic is a preferred asset the candidate also lacks.

jobs.title: Strategic Litigation Team Manager
jobs.reason: Field is core (human rights, strategic litigation) but this is a Manager-level role at the "Project/Regional Leads/Managers" band, requiring substantial litigation and team leadership experience the candidate (MSc in progress, RA-only background) does not have. Hard ineligibility on seniority.
jobs.salary: £52,088 plus up to 5% employee matched pension contribution

jobs.title: Fundraising Coordinator
jobs.reason: Although Reprieve's mission aligns with the candidate's human rights interests, fundraising/development is off-profile — it requires donor relations, fundraising-campaign and grants-management skills the candidate has not demonstrated. The role is entry-level but the functional fit is weak.
jobs.salary: £32,696 per annum plus up to 5% employee matched pension contribution

jobs.title: Lecturer in International Law and Politics
jobs.reason: Field alignment is excellent — international law, war crimes, atrocity legacies and peace/conflict at KCL War Studies is core to the candidate's specialism. However, this is a Lecturer post on the Academic Education Pathway requiring an emerging research track record and capacity to lead UG/PG teaching, which effectively requires a PhD (or near-completion) and prior university teaching experience — neither of which the candidate has. Hard ineligibility on seniority.
jobs.salary: £45,031 to £52,514 per annum including London Weighting
